title: Brother Printer Genuine Toner Fix - Use Any Toner
summary: A short walkthrough of a hack that tricks a Brother laser printer into accepting third-party toner by working around its genuine-toner check. It notes this may void the warranty.
why: Linked in printer DRM threads as proof that workarounds exist for Brother's cartridge restrictions.

quote.text: You can still (for now) get around the Toner DRM.
